subject: Hybrid Exec Workshop — venue access, AV interop, and on-site ops
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Venue access + preflight for Horizon exec workshop (Dec 18)

Hi team,

Planning check — Horizon is visiting the SF office for a half-day exec workshop on Dec 18 (09:00–14:00). We need to lock down the following by EOD Monday so Travel/Facilities and the customer experience are smooth: 

- Confirm room and secondary overflow space (they want hybrid AV + three remote panelists)
- Site access windows for vendor load-in and AV tech check (preferred: Fri Dec 17 16:00–20:00 or Sat 06:00–09:00)
- Point-of-contact for visitor check-in and escorting VIPs
- AV details: SIP bridge / STUN/TURN endpoints, room audio pickup plan, backup conferencing path (we've had issues with the building SIP-to-bridge in the past)
- Attendee list & badge names for building security

Attached: site_diagram_v2.pdf (floor plan) and attendee_access_list.csv (prelim). Laura will own sign-off; Marcus, can you route AV vendor options and confirm if we need an alternate bridge? Soojin, please confirm concierge and parking instructions. Ben, can you handle the guest dietary card we promised?

Thanks — this will be high-visibility with the execs and Horizon’s CISO in the room.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Events, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Pierce <alex@greengate.com>, Tim Baxter <tim.baxter@avone.io>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Venue access + preflight for Horizon exec workshop (Dec 18)

Thanks Laura — looping in GreenGate venue and AV-One so we can align on connectivity and drop windows. Alex / Tim — quick context: Horizon Insights will run a hybrid exec workshop (onsite + three remote panelists). We need:

1) Load-in access for AV rig: preferred Friday 16:00–20:00; fallback Saturday 06:00–09:00
2) Secure storage for two flight cases overnight
3) Verified SIP gateway creds and an alternate WebRTC path for failover (we had a SIP translation failure at a previous site)
4) Rack/power map and mic pickup plan (boundary vs ceiling) — attaching av_rack_map.xlsx for reference

Alex: can you confirm that security will pre-register the five Horizon VIP badges and provide an escort for arrival? Also need the courier entrance code — we’ll redact on the final distribution copy.

Tim: please share the SIP trunk details and whether AV-One can provision a TURN/STUN relay and an RTP fallback if the primary bridge fails. If you have a brief SOW, please attach. We'd like to sign via DocuSign this week to lock rates.

Link to shared folder with diagrams and the attendee list: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-horizon-venue-docs

Attachments: av_rack_map.xlsx

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Events & Customer Programs, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Tim Baxter <tim.baxter@avone.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Alex Pierce <alex@greengate.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Venue access + preflight for Horizon exec workshop (Dec 18)

Marcus / Laura / Alex,

Thanks for the context. AV-One can support the event; summary below and next steps:

- Proposed connectivity: primary SIP to PSTN bridge (sip.avone.io:5061) with SIP credentials (will provide securely), plus TURN/STUN on relay.turn.avone.io (ports 3478/5349) for WebRTC fallback.
- Hybrid topology: room sound via two ceiling arrays + one boundary mic; console outputs to both SIP bridge and local laptop for redundancy. We recommend the laptop as an alternate if the SIP gateway stalls — the laptop will be configured for Zoom/Teams/Meet as required.
- Rack footprint: 2RU encoder, 1RU decoder, 1RU UPS. See attached SOW excerpt and the detailed rack map.
- On-site crew: 2x engineers for load-in, 1x on-call for the event window. Load-in ETA Fri 16:30; we can start checks immediately after.

DocuSign SOW: https://app.docusign.com/transactions/2A3B4C5D6E
Attachments: SOW_AV-One-Dec2026.pdf

Questions for Marcus / Alex:
1) Can building security pre-authorize AV-One engineers for badge access? If so please provide full legal names and DOBs in the secure folder.
2) Is there an alternate bridge provider authorized by the customer (we can stand up WebRTC fallback but need network ports open from the building to the relay).

I’ll send the secure credential package via your preferred secret channel once we have the SOW signed.

—Tim Baxter
Lead Systems Engineer, AV-One
tim.baxter@avone.io
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Pierce <alex@greengate.com>, Tim Baxter <tim.baxter@avone.io>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, accounts@greengate.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Venue access + preflight for Horizon exec workshop (Dec 18)

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Tim and Alex. Confirming agreed items and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

- Venue & rooms: Main boardroom confirmed (capacity 18) + overflow rooms A/B (breakouts). GreenGate will reserve the rooms and confirm at 10:00 PT on Monday.
- Load-in window: Friday Dec 17 16:30–20:30 (AV-One crew of 2).
- Security & access: GreenGate to pre-register Horizon VIP badges; Marcus will upload final badge list to the secure Drive folder by 12:00 PT Mon. Alex to confirm courier entrance code to Marcus privately (we will not distribute in-thread).
- AV topology & failover: AV-One provides SIP bridge + TURN/STUN for WebRTC fallback; laptop fallback configured. Tim to provide credential package via encrypted channel after SOW is signed.
- DocuSign: Marcus to review SOW and complete signature; finance to approve PO if needed. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/transactions/2A3B4C5D6E
- On-site contacts:
  - Venue contact (Alex Pierce, GreenGate): +1 415-555-0116
  - AV lead (Tim Baxter, AV-One): +1 415-555-0189
  - Redwood coordinator (Marcus Lin): +1 415-555-0133

Next actions (owners):
- Marcus: upload final attendee list and sign SOW by Tue EOD (owner: marcus_lin)
- Alex: confirm security pre-registration and courier entry code by Mon 10:00 PT (owner: alex@greengate.com)
- Tim: add TURN/STUN IP allowlist and confirm exact SIP codec preferences (owner: tim.baxter@avone.io)
- Soojin: confirm concierge & parking instructions and vendor loading dock access (owner: soojin_lee)
- Ben: finalize dietary requirements and table cards (owner: ben_carter)

I'll share a final one-page ops sheet and a sanitized distribution copy of the badge list on Monday after Alex confirms the courier code. Thanks everyone — we should be set once the SOW is signed and security is confirmed.
